title: Claire Castro denies having personal issues with Baguio City Mayor Magalong
summary: Palace Press Officer Claire Castro said Friday that she has no personal issues with Baguio City Mayor Benjamin Magalong, claiming that they even shared a “power hug” while in an event in Malacañang.
